Welcome to the Grafana learning path that walks you through creating an alert rule. You will open the Alerting section, name a rule, write a query, set conditions, choose evaluation timing, and save the rule so Grafana starts monitoring your data.

## Here's what to expect

When you finish this path, you will be able to:

- Navigate to the Alert rules page and start a new rule
- Enter a rule name and build a query that tells Grafana what data to watch
- Configure a condition that decides when the alert fires
- Organize the rule in a folder and add labels for routing
- Set how often Grafana checks the condition and how long it must be true before firing
- Choose what happens when data is missing or returns an error
- Pick a contact point so you receive notifications
- Save the rule and confirm it appears in the rules list

## Before you begin

Make sure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account with Editor or Admin permissions.
- At least one data source (such as Prometheus, Mimir, or Loki) sending data to Grafana Cloud.
- A contact point already configured, or the default email contact point available.
